description: This file contains a class MicCaptureManager responsible for managing microphone input, speech recognition, and handling voice conversation flow in an Android application. It integrates with Android's SpeechRecognizer API, manages recognition sessions, handles recognition results, communicates with a gateway for processing voice input, and controls UI states related to speech input.

classes.name: VoiceConversationRole
classes.description: An enum class representing roles in a voice conversation, indicating whether the participant is the User or the Assistant.

classes.name: VoiceConversationEntry
classes.description: A data class representing an entry in the voice conversation, including its ID, role, text content, and streaming status.

classes.name: MicCaptureManager
classes.description: A class managing microphone input, speech recognition sessions, communication with a gateway, and conversation state in an Android application.

methods.name: setMicEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables microphone listening, starting or stopping recognition sessions accordingly.

methods.name: pauseForTts
methods.description: Pauses microphone input for text-to-speech playback, canceling recognition as needed.

methods.name: resumeAfterTts
methods.description: Resumes microphone input after TTS playback, restarting recognition session if appropriate.

methods.name: onGatewayConnectionChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in connection status with the voice processing gateway.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming events from the gateway related to voice recognition and assistant responses.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts a speech recognition session if permissions and hardware are available.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the current speech recognition session and cleans up resources.

methods.name: startListeningSession
methods.description: Configures and begins a speech recognition session.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of recognition after a delay, used for error recovery.

methods.name: queueRecognizedMessage
methods.description: Adds recognized speech text to the message queue and conversation history.

methods.name: scheduleTranscriptFlush
methods.description: Schedules flushing of partial transcripts into message queue after a timeout.

methods.name: publishQueue
methods.description: Updates the observable list of queued messages.

methods.name: sendQueuedIfIdle
methods.description: Sends the next message in the queue if the system is idle and connected.

methods.name: armPendingRunTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for the current voice recognition run, cancelling if it exceeds duration.

methods.name: completePendingTurn
methods.description: Marks the current turn as complete and proceeds to the next queued message.

methods.name: queuedWaitingStatus
methods.description: Returns a status message indicating the number of queued items and waiting state.

methods.name: appendConversation
methods.description: Appends a new entry to the conversation list.

methods.name: updateConversationEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing conversation entry with new text or streaming status.

methods.name: upsertPendingAssistant
methods.description: Inserts or updates the assistant's latest message in the conversation.

methods.name: playAssistantReplyAsync
methods.description: Speaks the assistant's reply asynchronously.

methods.name: disableMic
methods.description: Disables the microphone and cleans up recognizer resources.

methods.name: hasMicPermission
methods.description: Checks if the microphone permission has been granted.

methods.name: parseAssistantText
methods.description: Parses the assistant message content from a JSON payload.
